advisory.title: Guidance for your crop
advisory.disclaimer: This is general decision-support guidance, not a validated scientific diagnosis or a prescription. Always confirm with an expert before taking major action.
advisory.empty: Guidance is not available for this report yet.

section.rejected_notice: This report was marked as not supported by an expert. The image or details may not have been clear enough to assess.
section.resubmit_guidance: Consider submitting a new report with a clearer photo, taken in good light and close to the affected leaves or plant part.
section.no_diagnosis_yet: No automatic assessment is available for this report yet.
section.general_hygiene: Keep the field clean: remove fallen leaves and plant debris, and avoid working in the field when leaves are wet.
section.contact_expert_always: Contact your local agriculture extension officer for a proper assessment of this report.
section.awaiting_review_notice: An expert has not reviewed this report yet. Treat this as an early signal, not a confirmed result.
section.monitoring_basic: Check the plant again every few days and note any change.
section.likely_healthy_notice: The AI assessment suggests this plant may be healthy, but this is not confirmed.
section.ai_disease_notice: The AI assessment suggests a possible disease or disorder. This is not confirmed - treat it as an early signal.
section.ai_pest_notice: The AI assessment suggests a possible pest issue. This is not confirmed - treat it as an early signal.
section.ai_generic_notice: The AI assessment could not clearly identify the issue. Treat this as an early signal only.
section.ipm_cultural: Cultural practice: remove and dispose of visibly affected leaves or plants, rotate crops where possible, and avoid overcrowding plants.
section.ipm_mechanical: Mechanical control: hand-remove pests or affected plant parts where practical, and use physical barriers or traps if available.
section.ipm_biological: Biological control: encourage natural predators and beneficial insects in the field; avoid unnecessary disturbance to them.
section.monitoring_by_risk: Monitor the field regularly. Current risk level: {{risk_level}}.
section.contact_expert_conditional: If the condition spreads or does not improve, contact your local agriculture extension officer or laboratory for confirmation.
section.confirmed_healthy_notice: An expert has confirmed this plant appears healthy.
section.confirmed_disease_notice: An expert has confirmed a disease or disorder on this crop.
section.confirmed_pest_notice: An expert has confirmed a pest issue on this crop.
section.safe_input_notice: If you use any crop-protection product, always read and follow the product label, use recommended protective equipment, and observe the stated waiting period before harvest. Consult a licensed expert for product-specific advice - this app does not recommend specific products or doses.
section.contact_expert_always_confirmed: Discuss recommended management steps with your local agriculture extension officer.
section.generic_notice: General guidance is shown below. Contact your local agriculture extension officer for a full assessment.
